products.name: Trenova ESSENTIAL HOODIE
products.shortDescription: Minimal hoodie with brushed fleece and refined structure.
products.description: The Trenova Essential Hoodie balances softness and structure. Brushed fleece interior, clean kangaroo pocket, and understated hardware deliver a premium everyday layer.

products.name: Trenova DRY-FIT T-SHIRT
products.shortDescription: Breathable performance dry-fit tee.
products.description: Engineered with lightweight dry-fit fabric for moisture management and maximum comfort during workout and daily activities.

products.name: Trenova JOGGERS PREMIUM
products.shortDescription: Tapered premium stretch joggers.
products.description: Crafted with soft stretch cotton fabric, deep zipped pockets, and custom tapered fit.

products.name: Trenova ACTIVE CROP TOP
products.shortDescription: Seamless supportive active crop top.
products.description: Seamless design engineered for active lifestyles with high flexibility and breathable knit texture.

products.name: Trenova PREMIUM CAP
products.shortDescription: Structured luxury cotton cap with gold embroidery.
products.description: Structured 6-panel strapback cap featuring high-density gold metallic Trenova emblem.

products.name: Trenova SPORTS SOCKS (PACK OF 3)
products.shortDescription: Cushioned arch support performance crew socks.
products.description: Reinforced heel and toe with ribbed arch support for high performance and luxury everyday wear.

products.name: Lumen Classic Polo
products.shortDescription: Crisp polo with a clean collar and premium piqué knit.
products.description: The Lumen Classic Polo is built for elevated everyday wear. Soft piqué cotton, a precise collar, and a tailored yet comfortable fit make it ideal from desk to weekend.

products.name: Aero Utility Jacket
products.shortDescription: Lightweight utility jacket with clean modern lines.
products.description: The Aero Utility Jacket layers easily over tees and hoodies. Lightweight shell, functional pockets, and a minimal silhouette keep it sharp without feeling heavy.

products.name: Stride Tapered Joggers
products.shortDescription: Tapered joggers engineered for movement and ease.
products.description: Stride Tapered Joggers combine soft stretch fabric with a clean tapered silhouette. Perfect for travel, training recovery, and elevated lounge wear.

products.name: Coast Everyday Shorts
products.shortDescription: Breathable shorts with a clean tailored casual cut.
products.description: Coast Everyday Shorts are cut for warm days and easy movement. Soft fabric, refined length, and a versatile silhouette that works from city walks to travel.

products.name: Velvet Soft Tee
products.shortDescription: Women's soft tee with an elegant everyday drape.
products.description: The Velvet Soft Tee is designed for elevated comfort. Soft hand-feel, flattering cut, and a minimal finish that pairs with denim, skirts, and layered looks.

products.name: Pulse Active Set
products.shortDescription: Performance activewear built for studio and street.
products.description: The Pulse Active Set blends stretch, support, and a sleek silhouette. Designed for training sessions and polished athleisure styling outside the gym.
